summary: Fourth testing run completed. Two new features tested: 1) Multi-year comparison reports with 5 years of data (income, expenses, net_cashflow, repairs) per property with bar chart and table, 2) Portfolio growth historical tracking with daily snapshots, line chart on dashboard showing market value & equity over 30 days. Backend: 11/11 tests passed (100%). Frontend: All new features verified working via UI testing. Existing features (dashboard, properties, reports export) continue to work correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: Multi-Year Comparison Backend: GET /api/reports/comparison/{property_id} returns 5 years of data (current year - 4 to current year)
Comparison Data Structure: Each year includes income, expenses, net_cashflow, repairs, expense_categories, entry_count
Comparison Repairs Calculation: Correctly sums expenses with category in ['repairs', 'repeated repairs', 'maintenance']
Comparison Net Cashflow: Correctly calculated as income - expenses for each year
Portfolio Snapshot Backend: POST /api/portfolio/snapshot creates or updates daily snapshot (idempotent)
Portfolio Snapshot Data: Includes total_properties, total_market_value, total_purchase_value, total_equity, total_loans, ytd_income, ytd_expenses, net_cashflow
Portfolio History Backend: GET /api/portfolio/history returns snapshots sorted by date ascending
Portfolio History Seeded Data: 30 historical snapshots exist spanning approximately 30 days
Dashboard Portfolio Growth Chart: LineChart component displays two datasets - Market Value (green) and Equity (orange)
Dashboard Auto-Snapshot: Dashboard fetches /api/portfolio/history and auto-posts /api/portfolio/snapshot on load
Reports Tab Switcher: Two tabs - 'Export Reports' and 'Year Comparison' with proper testID attributes
Year Comparison UI: Shows property name, purchase/current values, bar chart (Net Cashflow by Year), and table with Year/Income/Expenses/Net/Repairs columns
Year Comparison Chart: BarChart displays net_cashflow for each year with proper labels and formatting
Year Comparison Table: Displays all years with data, color-coded values (green for income, red for expenses/negative net)
Export Reports Tab: Still functional with PDF Report and CSV Export buttons for each property
All existing features continue to work: Dashboard metrics, Property Performance cards, Income vs Expenses chart, Cashflow Trend, Expense Breakdown, Properties tab, Property detail screens
seed_data_creation: 30 portfolio snapshots seeded for past 30 days. Test property prop_c0e2f1669631 has expense data for year comparison.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Two new features fully functional: 1) Multi-year comparison reports - backend returns 5 years of financial data per property, frontend shows tab switcher in Reports screen with 'Year Comparison' tab displaying bar chart and table for each property. 2) Portfolio growth tracking - backend has snapshot creation (idempotent) and history retrieval endpoints, 30 historical snapshots seeded, frontend dashboard shows Portfolio Growth line chart with Market Value and Equity lines over 30 days. All existing features (Dashboard, Properties, Income, Expenses, Reports Export, Settings) continue to work correctly.
